answer.text: The key can be removed only when the ignition is OFF or the steering is locked, so with the ignition ON and the steering not locked, it stays in.

watchouts.text: Do not switch the ignition OFF while riding. Doing so can cause a potential accident, resulting in serious injury to you and other road users, and severe damage to the motorcycle.
Turn the ignition OFF when the engine is not running. If it is left ON, the headlamp stays on and discharges the battery.

watchout_review.reason: Warns against switching the ignition OFF while riding, which is the other way the key could be removed.
States the consequences of switching the ignition OFF while riding.
Cautions about leaving the ignition ON when the engine is not running.
